text:
Maria Gomez: customer says invoice shows ~1.6k extra tokens compared to their local SDK estimator. they sent a tiny prompt and expected <200 tokens billed. need quick repro and root-cause
Alex Li: can you paste the minimal curl and which SDK/version they used?
Maria Gomez: here's the sanitized curl they provided. note they stream the response and use --no-buffer to forward chunks to their UI.
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\n    "model": "open-2048v1",\n    "stream": true,\n    "messages": [\n      {"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},\n      {"role":"user","content":"Short paragraph -> 3 bullets."}\n    ],\n    "functions": [{"name":"web_lookup","parameters":{}}]\n  }' --no-buffer
```
Maria Gomez: customer says SDK estimator = 178 tokens, invoice shows 1778. they used a function plugin; they didn't locally tokenize the function response. also their client timed out and reconnected once
Samir Patel: likely causes: server-inserted routing/kv metadata that gets tokenized, function outputs appended server-side, and streaming reconnects creating separate metering events when session_id isn't present
Danielle (Billing): checked account logs for cus_ABC123. root request id r-9f8e7d6c shows we attached a base64 __route_metadata blob (~1.2k chars). when tokenized that explains most of the delta
Alex Li: can we reproduce quickly in staging and show the difference when metadata is disabled?
Samir Patel: repro in staging (internal header to disable metadata):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer STAGING_KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -H \"X-Redwood-Disable-Metadata: true\" \\
  -d '{"model":"open-2048v1","stream":false,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Short paragraph -> 3 bullets."}],"functions":[{"name":"web_lookup","parameters":{}}]}'
```
Samir Patel: results: with metadata disabled, metered tokens ~= client estimate + function output tokens. with metadata enabled, metered tokens = client estimate + metadata tokens + function output. in this customer's case web_lookup returned ~800 chars and route metadata ~1.2k chars -> matches invoice
Maria Gomez: customer had a streaming reconnect (network flap) and they didn't send a session id. do streaming reconnects duplicate counts?
Samir Patel: yes if there's no session/session_id dedupe. reconnect can produce a new request id and separate meter entry. SDKs usually set a session id by default; their raw curl did not
Maria Gomez: proposed immediate remediation for this customer: 1) issue a one-time credit for the delta 2) ask them to re-run tests with a session id and with metadata disabled 3) recommend using official SDK which sets session_id automatically
Danielle (Billing): credit issued for delta (case=89012, account=cus_ABC123). flagged account for 7-day monitoring and sent repro steps
Alex Li: engineering follow-up: add transparent tokens breakdown header (X-Redwood-Tokens-Breakdown) listing server_injected / function_output / client_sent so clients can reconcile. also make dedupe more robust for streaming reconnects
Samir Patel: opened ENG-4872 (tokens-breakdown-header) and ENG-4873 (streaming-dedupe-by-session). also note to product: expose a dashboard toggle showing server-injected token contributions
Maria Gomez: customer acknowledged credit and will re-run this afternoon with the headers we provided. they asked for a quick python tokenizer snippet we can share
Maria Gomez: suggested python snippet:
```
# quick_token_count.py (illustrative)
from redwood_tokenizer import count_tokens
prompt = "You are a concise assistant." + "Short paragraph -> 3 bullets."
print('prompt_tokens:', count_tokens(prompt))
# also run on server metadata blob and function response to compare
```
Support-bot: incident-note: billing-credit-applied account=cus_ABC123 reason=server-metadata-invoice-delta case=89012 credit_id=cred_5566
Maria Gomez: closing for now, will reopen if customer still sees a discrepancy after repro :thumbsup:
